info.title: FossaPay API
info.description: FossaPay API for checkout wallets, master-wallet payouts, customer management, NGN wallets, crypto wallets, transfers, fees, banks, and webhooks.

post.description: Free internal transfer between two FossaPay customers under the same business. Both accounts must be FossaPay NGN wallets.

post.summary: Transfer NGN to an external bank
post.description: Send NGN to an account at another supported Nigerian bank. Use wallet-to-wallet transfer instead when both customers belong to the same FossaPay business.

post.summary: Sign and broadcast with the master Solana wallet
post.description: Validates and simulates a serialized Solana versioned transaction, then signs and broadcasts it with the authenticated merchant's active master wallet. The selected wallet must be a required signer and the fee payer. A 202 response represents submission, not on-chain finality.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique merchant-scoped key for this exact signing request. Maximum 255 characters.

400.description: Malformed or unsupported transaction, wrong fee payer, missing co-signer, or invalid idempotency header

404.description: Active master Solana wallet not found

409.description: Idempotency key conflict or request already processing

post.summary: Sign and broadcast with a customer Solana wallet
post.description: Verifies that the customer belongs to the authenticated merchant, validates and simulates a serialized Solana versioned transaction, then signs and broadcasts it with the customer's active wallet. The selected wallet must be a required signer and the fee payer. A 202 response represents submission, not on-chain finality.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: FossaPay customer UUID owned by the authenticated merchant.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique merchant-scoped key for this exact signing request. Maximum 255 characters.

404.description: Customer or active customer Solana wallet not found

409.description: Idempotency key conflict or request already processing

get.description: Returns provider-reported SOL, USDC, and USDT balances for a customer owned by the authenticated merchant. Unsupported Solana token deposits appear in transaction history, not this balance response.

post.summary: Create a payout from the merchant master NGN wallet
post.description: The source wallet is derived from the authenticated merchant. Same-business destinations are free; cross-business FossaPay and external-bank destinations incur the configured payout fee.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for this logical payout. Idempotency-Key is also accepted; if both headers are sent, they must match.

202.description: Payout accepted, completed synchronously, or idempotently replayed

400.description: Validation, wallet, funds, configuration, provider, or idempotency-header error

401.description: Missing, invalid, inactive, revoked, non-live, or non-full-permission API key

409.description: Duplicate reference or incompatible idempotency-key reuse

post.summary: Create an immediate bulk payout batch
post.description: Validates a CSV, charges the configured payout fee per recipient, and submits an immediate all-or-nothing batch from a merchant-owned master or subaccount wallet.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for this logical batch. Idempotency-Key is also accepted; if both headers are sent, they must match.

202.description: Batch accepted for processing or idempotently replayed

400.description: Invalid multipart request, CSV row, bank, source wallet, balance, configuration, or provider request

401.description: Missing, invalid, inactive, revoked, non-live, or non-full-permission API key

409.description: Duplicate global batch reference or incompatible idempotency-key reuse

503.description: Batch service is temporarily unavailable or the outcome requires reconciliation

200.description: Merchant batches retrieved in reverse creation order

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: FossaPay batch ID returned by the create endpoint.

walletId.description: Wallet identifier returned by the custody provider. It is distinct from the internal crypto-address UUID used by some retrieval endpoints.

reference.description: Unique customer inter-bank transfer reference. Must be 36 characters or fewer.

serializedTransaction.description: Base64-encoded serialized Solana VersionedTransaction. The selected FossaPay wallet must be a required signer and the fee payer; all other required signers must already have signed.

id.description: FossaPay crypto wallet id. Use this UUID for wallet-by-id and wallet-transactions endpoints.

walletId.description: Provider wallet identifier retained for backward compatibility; not the id expected by FossaPay wallet endpoints.

id.description: FossaPay crypto wallet id used by wallet-by-id and wallet-transactions endpoints.

tokens.description: Provider-reported supported balances. SOL is the native network token; unsupported token deposits are recorded as transactions but omitted here.

cryptoAssetStatus.description: Unsupported means the token was received on-chain but is not spendable through FossaPay.

amount.description: Gross token amount. FossaPay deducts the quoted transfer fee, if any, and sends the remainder to the recipient. SOL amounts support up to 9 decimal places.
Amount the beneficiary receives in NGN.
